title: Hosea's Marriage to Gomer
summary: The LORD tells Hosea to take a wife of whoredoms and have children, since the land has committed great whoredom. Hosea marries Gomer, who bears Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah ('not pitied') and Lo-ammi ('not my people'). The LORD promises that Judah and Israel will be gathered and called children of the living God. Gomer later goes after lovers, and the LORD tells Hosea to love her again; he buys her for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley, and she is to wait many days.
